### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

Your Global Partner in Injection Molding Solutions

# Complete Manufacturing Systems and Services for Every Industry

Founded in 1953, Husky is a global provider of injection molding systems, hot runners, mold
controllers, and proactive monitoring services, specializing in solutions for PET preform and bottle
production, food packaging applications, consumer goods, and medical device manufacturing.

The future is accelerating and industries are reconfiguring, but one truth remains: innovation
requires constant drive.

That's why Husky builds beyond the moment. We adapt systems to evolving needs. We're not just a
machine supplier. We're a technology partner defining the future of manufacturing itself.

Husky transforms factories into intelligent networks, leveraging sustainability as a competitive
advantage and embedding foresight into the systems our customers run every day. From bottles and
consumer packaging to life-saving medical devices, our solutions are built for the pressures testing
today's industries, the opportunities redefining tomorrow, and the customers whose success powers
every day.

[Explore Our Injection Molding Systems][196]
Powering Production Excellence

## Complete Injection Molding Systems for Global Industries

Husky enables the production of finished products for a diverse range of  markets, including PET
preform manufacturing for beverage producers, thinwall food containers for packaging manufacturers,
beverage and specialty closures, consumer goods for retail brands, medical and pharmaceutical
molding for healthcare applications, electronic components, and more.

[Find the Right Injection Molding Solution for Your Market][197]
[People shaking hands after deciding on the right plastics manufacturing solution]
Complete Manufacturing Solutions

## End-to-End Injection Molding Solutions

Husky offers more than just systems and equipment. As a leading plastic injection molding supplier,
we gain a full understanding of your business, how it operates, your production goals, and the needs
of your customers. We then work with you to arrive at just the right operational setup, deliver and
install it onsite, and train your team to ensure you are up and running according to your exact
specifications.

Through our [Husky Advantage+Elite™][198] service, we provide real-time proactive, predictive, and
transparent monitoring. If we recognize a decline in equipment performance, we call you to address
issues before they result in unplanned downtime. Additionally, we stay connected with you throughout
the life of your system with genuine OEM parts, technical assistance, and troubleshooting support.  

[Our Solutions][199]
[Husky technicians working on an injection molding system]
Investment that Delivers

## Why Choose Husky for Injection Molding Service and Support?

From the moment you purchase your first Husky[ injection molding system][200] to years down the
road, we are dedicated to your long-term success and will work with you every step of the way to
enable optimal performance and the lowest part costs.

Husky stands apart by providing proactive, predictive, and transparent services, along with process
and production monitoring. Our support includes extended protection and maintenance plans, machine
audits, equipment refurbishments, upgrades, and more.

[Our Services][201]
[A historical photo of Husky technicians running an injection molding system]
GET TO KNOW HUSKY

## About Us

Since 1953, Husky has led the world in plastic injection molding innovation. Supporting customers in
more than 140 countries, our worldwide network enables us to understand unique regional needs and
deliver responsive, local support wherever you operate.

[Learn More About Husky][202]
Expert Knowledge

## Industry Insights & Technical Resources

Explore Husky's library of technical insights, customer success stories, and industry updates. Our
content enables you stay informed with:
* **Technical Insights:** Industry trends and injection molding innovations
* **Application Spotlights: **Real-world customer success stories
* **Product Updates:** Latest system features and capabilities
* **Best Practices: **Operational guidance for maximizing performance

[Browse Resources to Optimize Your Operation][203]

Your Global Partner in Injection Molding Solutions

# Complete Manufacturing Systems and Services for Every Industry

Founded in 1953, Husky is a global provider of injection molding systems, hot runners, mold
controllers, and proactive monitoring services, specializing in solutions for PET preform and bottle
production, food packaging applications, consumer goods, and medical device manufacturing.

The future is accelerating and industries are reconfiguring, but one truth remains: innovation
requires constant drive.

That's why Husky builds beyond the moment. We adapt systems to evolving needs. We're not just a
machine supplier. We're a technology partner defining the future of manufacturing itself.

Husky transforms factories into intelligent networks, leveraging sustainability as a competitive
advantage and embedding foresight into the systems our customers run every day. From bottles and
consumer packaging to life-saving medical devices, our solutions are built for the pressures testing
today's industries, the opportunities redefining tomorrow, and the customers whose success powers
every day.

[Explore Our Injection Molding Systems][196]
Powering Production Excellence

## Complete Injection Molding Systems for Global Industries

Husky enables the production of finished products for a diverse range of  markets, including PET
preform manufacturing for beverage producers, thinwall food containers for packaging manufacturers,
beverage and specialty closures, consumer goods for retail brands, medical and pharmaceutical
molding for healthcare applications, electronic components, and more.

[Find the Right Injection Molding Solution for Your Market][197]
[People shaking hands after deciding on the right plastics manufacturing solution]
Complete Manufacturing Solutions

## End-to-End Injection Molding Solutions

Husky offers more than just systems and equipment. As a leading plastic injection molding supplier,
we gain a full understanding of your business, how it operates, your production goals, and the needs
of your customers. We then work with you to arrive at just the right operational setup, deliver and
install it onsite, and train your team to ensure you are up and running according to your exact
specifications.

Through our [Husky Advantage+Elite™][198] service, we provide real-time proactive, predictive, and
transparent monitoring. If we recognize a decline in equipment performance, we call you to address
issues before they result in unplanned downtime. Additionally, we stay connected with you throughout
the life of your system with genuine OEM parts, technical assistance, and troubleshooting support.  

[Our Solutions][199]
[Husky technicians working on an injection molding system]
Investment that Delivers

## Why Choose Husky for Injection Molding Service and Support?

From the moment you purchase your first Husky[ injection molding system][200] to years down the
road, we are dedicated to your long-term success and will work with you every step of the way to
enable optimal performance and the lowest part costs.

Husky stands apart by providing proactive, predictive, and transparent services, along with process
and production monitoring. Our support includes extended protection and maintenance plans, machine
audits, equipment refurbishments, upgrades, and more.

[Our Services][201]
[A historical photo of Husky technicians running an injection molding system]
GET TO KNOW HUSKY

## About Us

Since 1953, Husky has led the world in plastic injection molding innovation. Supporting customers in
more than 140 countries, our worldwide network enables us to understand unique regional needs and
deliver responsive, local support wherever you operate.

[Learn More About Husky][202]
Expert Knowledge

Explore Husky's library of technical insights, customer success stories, and industry updates. Our

* **Application Spotlights: **Real-world customer success stories
* **Product Updates:** Latest system features and capabilities

enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our

both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are

As a premier plastic distributor, Total Plastics stocks thousands of application-specific plastic
sheets, rods, tubes, and films — from UV-stable acrylic/plexiglass and impact-rated Lexan®
polycarbonate to high-temperature PEEK and chemical-resistant PTFE. We back our inventory with
precision CNC machining, custom fabrication, and fast nationwide delivery.

  interiors and components.
* **Automotive:** Impact-resistant polycarbonate panels, engineered polymer rods, and tubing for
  vehicle assemblies and trims.
* **Architecture & Construction:** UV-stable acrylic glazing, durable PVC and HDPE panels for
  building facades and design elements.
* **Medical & Life Sciences:** Biocompatible, medical-grade sheets and tubes for lab equipment,
  enclosures, and devices.
* **Marine:** Corrosion- and UV-resistant marine-grade HDPE, acrylic windshields, and Lexan® panels

  signs, and trade-show exhibits.

  tooling, and custom components.

## Who we are

### Employee orientation as a corporate philosophy

AGRU is a success story that has now been going on for eight decades. The company is one of the
world´s most important single-source suppliers for piping systems, semi-finished products, concrete
protective liners and geomembranes made of engineering plastics. We live out a primary goal in terms
of optimised work and general conditions in our daily cooperation. Training and further education
takes high priority. At AGRU, the plastic parts manufacturer, this social component is definitely
the status quo.

## The plastics experts.

### Thermoplastic products for infrastructure, industry, and utilities

AGRU is a leading plastic pipe manufacturer and supplier of high-quality fittings, semi-finished
products, geomembranes and concrete protective liners made from thermoplastic materials. Since its
foundation by Alois Gruber Sr. in 1948 in Upper Austria, AGRU has stood for innovation, operational
reliability, and quality. With our technological expertise and customer-oriented thermoplastic
solutions, we set standards in water, wastewater, energy supply, infrastructure, life sciences and
digitalization.

## Who we are

### Employee orientation as a corporate philosophy

AGRU is a success story that has now been going on for eight decades. The company is one of the
world´s most important single-source suppliers for piping systems, semi-finished products, concrete
protective liners and geomembranes made of engineering plastics. We live out a primary goal in terms
of optimised work and general conditions in our daily cooperation. Training and further education
takes high priority. At AGRU, the plastic parts manufacturer, this social component is definitely
the status quo.

## The plastics experts.

### Thermoplastic products for infrastructure, industry, and utilities

AGRU is a leading plastic pipe manufacturer and supplier of high-quality fittings, semi-finished
products, geomembranes and concrete protective liners made from thermoplastic materials. Since its
foundation by Alois Gruber Sr. in 1948 in Upper Austria, AGRU has stood for innovation, operational
reliability, and quality. With our technological expertise and customer-oriented thermoplastic
solutions, we set standards in water, wastewater, energy supply, infrastructure, life sciences and
digitalization.

Coimbatore, Hyderabad, Hosur, Pune, Mumbai, and Delhi.

Sometimes your parts reach your hands the same day.

For international shipping, parts can reach your hands in 3 to 6 days. Our DHL/FedEx partner can
ship your package as fast as 2 days.

‍

*Note: International orders have higher production priority as they have higher transit time than
local orders.

standards to make sure our customers are always satisfied. Our whole team, not just the quality
department, regularly checks in to see how we can do better. We take this feedback and act on it
right away, constantly improving our work in 3D printing and injection molding. Our main goal is to
give you a top-notch experience when you make your products with us. We’re all about making things
better, every step of the way.

- We are 100% committed to blending speed with quality, making sure our customers are satisfied with
their requirements with us.

- We always strive to deliver on time with as precise as 99% of the time and 0 PPM rejection.

- All orders leaving the Amuse facility come with signed inspection reports. Detailing the
dimensional differences from CAD.

- We commit ourselves to holding ownership for your product manufactured by us. Thus, if you feel
something isn't right or doesn't meet your CTQ, with your feedback, our team will take immediate
action to fix it in 24 hours.

- For serial production projects, we will provide you with complete quality planning and
pre-delivery production inspection records.

### Do you sign an NDA for our project?

Yes, we do. We at Amuse 3D know how important it is to keep your private and intellectual property
safe. That's why we're pleased to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) for your project.

We promise to keep your designs, data, and ideas safe, whether you give us a regular NDA or one we
can share. You may be sure that we will handle every project with the care and privacy it needs,
from the first file you provide us to the last one we deliver.
‍

Feel free to send your NDA to info@amuse3d.in to get started.

* [3D Printing Services][28] – covering FDM, SLA, and MJF technologies for prototypes and end-use
  parts.
* [CNC Machining][29] – for high-precision metal and plastic components.
* [Injection Moulding][30] – for scalable production runs with consistent quality.
* [Design and Application Engineering][31] – to support product development, reverse engineering,
  and design optimization.

This integrated setup allows seamless support from concept and prototyping to full-scale production.

### Which industries are served by these manufacturing solutions?

Advanced 3D printing and manufacturing services support a broad range of industries. The core
expertise lies in:
* [Aerospace and Defense][32] – for lightweight, high-strength, and precision components.

* [Drone and Robotics][34] – for durable, aerodynamic structures and housings.
* [Medical and Healthcare][35] – for anatomical models, jigs, and device prototypes.

In addition, these services extend to consumer products, industrial equipment, electronics,
architecture, and education, helping businesses in diverse sectors turn ideas into functional

### Blow Molded Plastic Supplier Directory Overview

Find, compare, and connect with blow molded plastic manufacturers, blow mold companies, and blow
molding suppliers serving packaging, industrial, automotive, medical, consumer, and material
handling markets. This directory helps buyers browse blow molding capabilities by product type,
process, material, and end-use requirement, making it easier to source the right manufacturing
partner for custom or high-volume production. Whether you need bottles, tanks, containers, ducts,
bins, housings, or other hollow plastic components, this page is built to help procurement teams,
engineers, and product developers review supplier options, compare processes, and move efficiently
from research to quote requests.

### Blow Molded Products and Applications

Blow molding suppliers in this directory produce hollow plastic parts used for packaging, storage,
transport, and product protection across a wide range of markets. Common outputs include bottles,
containers, tanks, cases, and other blow molded plastics designed for lightweight strength,
repeatability, and cost-efficient volume production. Buyers searching for plastic blow mold
solutions can compare suppliers by part size, wall construction, resin compatibility, and output
requirements while narrowing options based on whether the project calls for commodity packaging or a
more specialized industrial form.

### Blow Molding Processes and Manufacturing Methods

Many manufacturers also support process-specific production needs, including extrusion blow molding,
injection blow molding, and blow injection molding for applications that demand tighter dimensional
control or specific finish requirements. These methods are used to produce everything from small
medical and personal care containers to larger reservoirs, drums, and shaped housings for industrial
systems. For buyers researching blow molds or evaluating how different process routes affect
performance, this directory makes it easier to connect application requirements to supplier
capabilities.

### Industry Applications for Blow Molded Parts

Blow molded parts serve distinct production needs from one industry to the next. Food and beverage
operations often require lightweight containers with consistent wall distribution and reliable
sealing. Automotive programs may need ducts, reservoirs, and protective housings that balance
durability with weight reduction. Healthcare packaging depends on controlled small-part production
for bottles, vials, and similar containers. Consumer goods manufacturers use blow molded formats for
storage products, cases, and household packaging. Industrial and waste-handling applications rely on
larger containers, drums, and bins built for handling, transport, and chemical resistance.

### Production Volume and Supplier Selection

Production volume should shape your supplier shortlist early. Some projects require short runs for
custom development, while others need continuous high-throughput output for bottles, containers, and
repeat-order packaging. Buyers should compare suppliers based on tooling readiness, machine
capacity, cycle efficiency, and their ability to scale from pilot quantities to full production
without disrupting timelines.

### Blow Molding vs Injection Molding

Process selection also matters. Buyers comparing blow molding vs injection molding should start with
part geometry and end use: blow molding is generally better suited to hollow forms, while other
molding methods may be a better fit for solid or highly detailed parts. Within blow molding itself,
process choice affects clarity, wall consistency, handle design, neck finish, and achievable part
size. Matching the process to the product is one of the fastest ways to reduce cost and avoid
redesign.

### Integration and Downstream Manufacturing Requirements

Integration requirements should not be treated as an afterthought. If the molded part must move
directly into filling, capping, labeling, trimming, assembly, leak testing, or downstream packaging,
the supplier should be able to support those production realities. For industrial components, buyers
should also ask about secondary operations, custom tooling support, and how easily a supplier can
align with existing production lines, automation standards, and packaging workflows.

### Quality Control, Certification, and Compliance

Inspection and certification requirements are equally important when sourcing blow mold
manufacturers. Depending on the application, buyers may need food-contact documentation,

management compliance. Strong suppliers should be able to explain their quality controls, sampling
methods, validation approach, and how they manage consistency across repeated runs, especially when
the product is used in regulated or performance-sensitive environments.

intel.summary:
CHINAPLAS is the world’s leading plastics and rubber trade fair, organized by Adsale Exhibition
Services Ltd., and supported by many local and overseas associations.International Exhibition on
Plastics and Rubber Industries (CHINAPLAS) will be held on April 13-16, 2027 at Shenzhen World
Exhibition & Convention Center (Bao'an), PR China. CHINAPLAS is expected to reach over 390,000+ sqm
exhibition areas with over 5,000+ exhibitors from 40 countries and regions and 9 pavilions. It will
showcase more than 3,800 units of plastics and rubber machinery include extrusion and injection
machines, blow molding machines, ancillary & testing equipment, film technology, integrated
automation machines, and machines & equipment for preprocessing and re machines & equipment for
preprocessing and recycling cycling; and chemicals and raw materials cover additives, bioplastics,
3D printing materials, pigments, composite & high-performance materials, semi-finished products, and
thermoplastic elastomers & rubber, for the automotive, building & city infrastructure, E&E, IT &
telecommunications, end-user packaging, medical and other industries. It will attract 250,000
professional buyers, with 25% overseas visitors, from 150 countries and regions. The show will
highlight “Sustainability & Circular Economy”, “Digitalization & Smart Manufacturing”, “Innovation
Materials” and “High-end Technologies from China” in which integrated automation, composite
materials, 3D printing, and recycling technologies will be displayed together with the concurrent
events. All these contribute to the enterprises for upgrading the production process and
competitiveness. Over 5,000+ Global Exhibitors, including chemicals and raw materials suppliers like
DuPont, BASF, Dow Chemical, MITSUBISHI CHEMICAL, Kingfa, Covestro, LG Chemicals, etc to provide new
and advanced technology in chemicals field; and plastics and rubber machinery suppliers like
Haitian, Borch EDI, Engel, Jwell, Dalian Totani, Akei, BCC, Zerma, Avian, Yizumi, Husky, Nordson,
Solvay, Coperion, etc will display a wide range of plastics machinery include extrusion and
injection molding machines for different industries, e.g. plastic packaging; and mould and die
suppliers like Mold-Masters, Yudo, etc. In addition, for composite & high-performance materials,
there are exhibitors of Nippon Electric Glass, IKP, Taishan Fiberglass. While Demag, ISRA, ABB,
Tool-Temp, Italy Gimatic, KENT, Mehow, LITEON, LNC, Delta-Cimic, etc are the suppliers of industrial
automation machines. And Macchi, Jinming, and Hanking will display film technology.Visitors who
successfully pre-register online (www.ChinaplasOnline.com/prereg) can enjoy early bird fare
discount.

based on the English version of the website and it may occur incorrect results sometimes.

CHINAPLAS is the world’s leading plastics and rubber trade fair, organized by Adsale Exhibition
Services Ltd., and supported by many local and overseas associations.International Exhibition on
Plastics and Rubber Industries (CHINAPLAS) will be held on April 13-16, 2027 at Shenzhen World
Exhibition & Convention Center (Bao'an), PR China. CHINAPLAS is expected to reach over 390,000+ sqm
exhibition areas with over 5,000+ exhibitors from 40 countries and regions and 9 pavilions. It will
showcase more than 3,800 units of plastics and rubber machinery include extrusion and injection
machines, blow molding machines, ancillary & testing equipment, film technology, integrated
automation machines, and machines & equipment for preprocessing and re machines & equipment for
preprocessing and recycling cycling; and chemicals and raw materials cover additives, bioplastics,
3D printing materials, pigments, composite & high-performance materials, semi-finished products, and
thermoplastic elastomers & rubber, for the automotive, building & city infrastructure, E&E, IT &
telecommunications, end-user packaging, medical and other industries. It will attract 250,000
professional buyers, with 25% overseas visitors, from 150 countries and regions. The show will
highlight “Sustainability & Circular Economy”, “Digitalization & Smart Manufacturing”, “Innovation
Materials” and “High-end Technologies from China” in which integrated automation, composite
materials, 3D printing, and recycling technologies will be displayed together with the concurrent
events. All these contribute to the enterprises for upgrading the production process and
competitiveness. Over 5,000+ Global Exhibitors, including chemicals and raw materials suppliers like
DuPont, BASF, Dow Chemical, MITSUBISHI CHEMICAL, Kingfa, Covestro, LG Chemicals, etc to provide new
and advanced technology in chemicals field; and plastics and rubber machinery suppliers like
Haitian, Borch EDI, Engel, Jwell, Dalian Totani, Akei, BCC, Zerma, Avian, Yizumi, Husky, Nordson,
Solvay, Coperion, etc will display a wide range of plastics machinery include extrusion and
injection molding machines for different industries, e.g. plastic packaging; and mould and die
suppliers like Mold-Masters, Yudo, etc. In addition, for composite & high-performance materials,
there are exhibitors of Nippon Electric Glass, IKP, Taishan Fiberglass. While Demag, ISRA, ABB,
Tool-Temp, Italy Gimatic, KENT, Mehow, LITEON, LNC, Delta-Cimic, etc are the suppliers of industrial
automation machines. And Macchi, Jinming, and Hanking will display film technology.Visitors who
successfully pre-register online (www.ChinaplasOnline.com/prereg) can enjoy early bird fare
discount.

# DRIVING EVEN FASTER DATACOM

See why the rapid growth in AI/ML is driving a demand for faster datacom enabled by innovative
Coherent solutions.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

### Automotive & Energy Solutions

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

### Instrumentation

See how we’re helping professionals and institutions — from research facilities and OEMs to
hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][66]

## EVENTS

#### 1F, Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center (TaiNEX), Hall 2

Join Coherent at Laser & Photonics Taiwan 2026, the premier annual event for the laser and photonics
industry, showcasing the latest advancements in advanced manufacturing, smart automation,
semiconductors, electric vehicles, and biomedicine. Visit us at Booth P502 to discover cutting-edge
laser solutions and photonics technologies designed to power the next generation of manufacturing
and industrial applications. Meet with our experts and explore how Coherent is enabling innovation
across industries.

# DRIVING EVEN FASTER DATACOM

Coherent solutions.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

### Automotive & Energy Solutions

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

### Instrumentation

See how we’re helping professionals and institutions — from research facilities and OEMs to
hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][66]

Search for a company, add the desired reports to your cart, and pay securely by credit card. Reports

Duplicate orders will be refunded or replaced with another report. Respond to the email order

Yes, our reports come from authoritative sources and are widely accepted for KYC, compliance, and

We don’t manually add or remove data. Records are updated automatically once changes are filed with

Duplicate orders will be refunded or replaced with another report. Respond to the email order
confirmation you received and our team will help you.

international due diligence.

###### components and etc.

# Plastic Injection Molding Machine---DKM

DKM is a world famous plastic injection molding machine manufacturer and innovator in China,
offering qualified plastic injection machines, providing plastic molding technologies as well as
turnkey plastic injection molding line solutions.
DKM was established on 2007 year, keened on 5H molding mentality of High Speed, High precision, High
Energy Saving, High safety and High cycle stability during machines design and manufacturing. With
latest plastic injection molding technology, DKM has developed 6 series plastic injection molding
machines as below:
♦ Two Platen Injection Molding Machines from 600TON to 4600TON
♦ Standard Servo Plastic Injection Molding Machines from 90TON to 3350TON
♦ Low Inertia Servo Plastic Injection Molding Machine from 90TON to 3350TON
♦ High Speed Injection Molding Machines (Hybrid) 200TON to 600TON
♦ Medical Expert Clean Injection Molding Machine from 250TON to 650TON(MX series)
♦ PET expert for high speed PET preform injection molding machine from 250TON to 650TON
To support our customers with more competitive and profitable injection molding factory, DKM offers
one-stop integrate turnkey solution for building plastic injection molding factory, as well as
plastic injection molding production line.
DKM's strong scientific research force and rigorous quality mentality have won many good reputation
in the world. DKM team firmly believes that technology creates the future and quality leads
development.
In order to better serve users, DKM has truly laid service center globally. Focus on the mission of
MAKE MOLDING MORE VALUABLE, DKM has established service centers in more than 30 countries or
regions. With the increasing market share, DKM will continue to expand and improve its service
level, and will continue to lead the high-quality development of enterprises with service, quality
and technology.
Welcome to inquire and join us.

injection molds, molded parts, CNC machining, and prototype production for global industrial
customers.

Why Choose Deep Mould
* Over 10 years experience in injection molding and tooling manufacturing
* Strong capability in complex mold design and precision tooling
* Support from prototype to mass production
* In-house CNC machining for high-precision components
* Fast communication and lead time for global customers

Get a Quote for Your Project

From prototype development to mass production for different plastic part and hardware components, we
support projects with complex structures and tight tolerance requirements with different solutions
based on the request quantity demands. Send us the drawing or a real sample and the project
requirements,our team will respond with a detailed quotation and engineering feedback.

[REQUEST A QUOTE][77]

[icon] Plastic Injection Mold Testing Steps

1) Preparation: Complete the mold fabrication, choose the right inietion machine and materials
according the requirments

2) First Trial: Set different parameters to check defects and adjust it to have a good sample for
customers.

3) Adiust and Optimize: QC checking after 24 hours and and mold modification to improve the issues.

4) Second Trial: Reset the second mold testing and check product quality (appearance, accuracy,
ejection).

5) Sample Confirmation: Finalize samples and document production conditions.

6) Moldshipment & Maintenance: Once optimized, we will ship the mold to customers for mass
production.

[icon] CNC machining Parts Involve Steps

1) Design and CAD: Parts are designed by customer which need to provide us the STEP or X_T format.

2)CNC Programming: Deep's engineers will make the CNC programming to instruct machines onmachining
paths.

3)Material Selection: Materials like metals or plastics are chosen with customer's requirments.

4)Machining: CNC machines cut, mill, or drill parts with high precision tolerance.

5)Quality Control: Parts are inspected during machining with our QC department.

6)Finishing: Processes like oxidation,painting or coating improve appearance and durability.

7)Assembly and Testing: Parts are assembled and tested with function.

[icon] The Progress of 3D Printing Service

1) Design & Prototyping: Customers can semd us the drawings with STEP/STL format 3D files to create
prototypes, models or custom parts.

2) Materials: It includings PLA, ABS,PA12 and Titanium/SS

3) Techniques: SLA (Stereolithography) and SLS (Selective Laser Sintering) are used depending on the
requirements.

4) After-Processing: Including the polishing,painting or assembly.

5) Customization: MOQ:1pcs to show at the fair and test the assembly.

Quick lead time:3-10 days for testing and design validation.

Cost-Effective for Small Batches: Normally it takes around $50-$200 cost.

### Plastic Injection Moulding Manufacturers South Africa

Dela Plast is a proudly South African plastic injection moulding company, specialising in the
manufacturing of high-quality plastic products. Based in Pretoria, Gauteng, our world-class facility
is equipped to design and produce a wide variety of custom-moulded plastic components for clients
across diverse industries.

Through our professional [contract moulding service][32], we manufacture plastic components to your
exact specifications — from agricultural and engineering parts to specialised medical and
pharmaceutical products. At Dela Plast, we combine experience, precision, and innovation to deliver
reliable plastic solutions tailored to your needs.

Our factory operates in full accordance with FSSC 22000 (ISO 22000-4) standards, ensuring the
production of clean, safe, and high-quality plastic products that meet the strictest industry
requirements and consistently satisfy our customers’ needs.

Through our **[contract moulding services][33]**, we offer expert assistance with mould design and
development for new plastic products. In addition to custom manufacturing, we also supply our own
range of high-quality plastic products available for wholesale. Our product line includes **[storage
shelf bins][34], [agricultural items][35]** such as **[tomato hooks][36], [Dela Misters][37], and
[seed trays][38]**, all designed to meet the practical needs of various industries.

We welcome [resellers][39] to contact us to partner up with distributing our products.

personal care products. It acts as an opacifier, emulsifier, and thickening agent while also

# Caustic Soda Flakes

## ELRASA^{TM} – CSF99

Caustic soda flakes, also known as sodium hydroxide flakes, are a solid form of caustic soda (NaOH)
that appear white and crystalline. Highly soluble in water, these flakes produce a strong alkaline
solution. As one of the most potent alkalis, caustic soda is extremely corrosive and widely
recognized for its versatility across industrial sectors. It remains one of the most essential
chemical compounds produced and supplied by leading caustic soda producers worldwide.

## Surface Appearance

As with all things custom chrome emblem production in small quantities has limitations. Below are
the main limitations:
* The material is flat and consists of a Black Core.
* The surface finish is Brushed and Chrome (technically it's a nickle finish).

Now, We know what you're thinking: **I Don't want Brushed**. And believe us, we feel you.

Unfortunatley though, it's one of the limtations of production of chrome car emblems & badges at
small quantities. If they didn't have a brushed surface they'd reflect just like a mirror and you'd
only see the light reflect in one direction; all other directions not showing a reflection at all.
For this reason we have made them with a brushed appearance.

We've been in the custom emblem business since 2000, if there was a cost effective way to make
Chrome Emblems & Badges without a brushed appearance, we'd do it.

## Edges

Because the core is black, and we cut and etch through the top layer to make your custom chrome
emblem designs, the edges, and the etching will be black. However the material takes paint extremely
well. You can definitely paint the emblems & badges once you get them. However is not a service we
offer in house.

Unfortunatley we can’t offer any beveling or rounding of the edges either at these quantities.

## Thickness

Our custom chrome emblems & badges are 1/8″ thick. Unfortunately due to material manufacture
limitations we can’t make emblems thicker than this.

Also when etching into this material we can only go about .25mm deep. This is to assure that the
intgrity of the emblem holds up. We don’t want to make you an emblem that won’t last for years!!

## Adhesive

All our chrome emblems & badges are backed with a 3M automotive grade foam adhesive. This adhesive
is 1/32″ thick. This allows the emblems & badges to adhere not only to flat surfaces, but also
slightly curved or irregular surfaces as are often found on automotive fender panels.

We don’t offer chrome emblems & badges with mounting studs or screws. All emblems will need a
mounting surface to be installed on.

## Design And Design Files

The best type of design file to send us is something called a [Vector file][62]. However if you're
not aware of what vector files are, or you don't have the ability to create one we can help.

We offer services ranging from Simple Vector Conversion, to Premium, Full Logo design and branding.
[Click Here][63] for more information on the services we offer.

Custom Car emblems & badges are the best way to show off the hard work on your custom vehicle, or
even just to officially give your car a nickname. The custom chrome emblems & badges are
weatherproof and fadeproof. These custom chrome emblems & badges are UV stable and weatherable. They
will not break down due to the sun or other weather components.

The OEM automotive standard for car emblems & badges is an injection molded plastic that is chrome
plated. However that requires a minimum or 300 units to achieve. At smaller quantities we have

Our custom chrome emblems & badges are 1/8″ thick. Unfortunately due to material manufacture
limitations we can’t make emblems thicker than this.

Also when etching into this material we can only go about .25mm deep. This is to assure that the
intgrity of the emblem holds up. We don’t want to make you an emblem that won’t last for years!!

## Adhesive

All our chrome emblems & badges are backed with a 3M automotive grade foam adhesive. This adhesive
is 1/32″ thick. This allows the emblems & badges to adhere not only to flat surfaces, but also
slightly curved or irregular surfaces as are often found on automotive fender panels.

We don’t offer chrome emblems & badges with mounting studs or screws. All emblems will need a
mounting surface to be installed on.

## Design And Design Files

The best type of design file to send us is something called a [Vector file][62]. However if you're
not aware of what vector files are, or you don't have the ability to create one we can help.

We offer services ranging from Simple Vector Conversion, to Premium, Full Logo design and branding.
[Click Here][63] for more information on the services we offer.

##### Description:

Custom Chrome Car Emblems & Badges from Emblem Art are made from Automotive grade plastics and are
manufactured right here in the U.S.A.!!! They are the perfect addition to any build, or product
badging. These custom chrome emblems & badges will make your project one-of-a-kind.

Custom Car emblems & badges are the best way to show off the hard work on your custom vehicle, or
even just to officially give your car a nickname. The custom chrome emblems & badges are
weatherproof and fadeproof. These custom chrome emblems & badges are UV stable and weatherable. They
will not break down due to the sun or other weather components.

The OEM automotive standard for car emblems & badges is an injection molded plastic that is chrome
plated. However that requires a minimum or 300 units to achieve. At smaller quantities we have
developed a plastic material that is processed differently, so it looks a bit different, but is
still the same durability as OEM car emblems & badges.

These chrome emblems & badges, while being the same quality as OEM chrome emblem styling, are
produced differently, so they have some limitations, however the tradeoff is that you can get your
own custom chrome emblem without the huge cost of a full production run.

We can make these as Automotive Emblems or for any product as well. As a matter of fact, many
business starting up use this material for branding their products.

# Innovative Thermoplastic Solutions

Custom engineered masterbatch slip additive formulations that provide thermoplastic manufacturers
with superior plastic products.

[[Innovative Thermoplastic Solutions]][10]

### [Silaplast™ Thermoplastic Slip Additive][11]

Proprietary engineered thermoplastic slip additives that offer a multitude of benefits for
thermoplastic manufacturing.

Scratch & Abrasion Resistance • Reduce Die Buildup • Smoother Surfaces

[Silaplast™ Thermoplastic Slip Additives][12]

#### [Thermoplastic Slip Additives][13]

Engineered thermoplastic slip additive formulations to improve numerous manufacturing processes and
fix errors.

[thermoplastic manufacturing]

Innovative solutions for clients with specific thermoplastic manufacturing requirements.

[Thermoplastic Solutions][16]

##### Superior Thermoplastic Innovations

Application specific thermoplastic additive siloxane (PDMS as well as organo-functional) solutions.

##### Customer Centric

Our customers are as unique as our thermoplastic solutions. We go out of our way to provide them
with every opportunity to achieve thermoplastic manufacturing success.

##### 25+ Years Experience

Advanced thermoplastic engineering knowledge and manufacturing experience in the fields of
automotive plastics, medical devices, silicone and thermoplastic chemistry, and plastic processing
technology.

Integrating expansive mold designing and parts manufacturing experience, Fox Mold offers a range of

## Our Capabilities

## / Services /

Plastic Injection Molding

The cost-effective plastic injection molding process produces highly durable and consistent plastic
parts with tight tolerances.

[Learn More][49]
LSR Injection Molding

Create complex silicone rubber parts with ease using our cutting-edge LSR injection molding process
with consistent quality at shorter production times.

[Learn More][50]
Metal Insert Injection Molding

Efficiently produce plastic molded parts with metal inserts that add durability and functionality
while staying cost-effective.

[Learn More][51]
Overmolding Injection Molding

GTP has been a trusted leader in functional injection molding since 1981. Proudly based in Grand
Traverse County, Michigan, we are a U.S.-based manufacturer delivering high-quality, custom-molded
solutions to clients worldwide.

With deep expertise in design, engineering, and automation, we leverage advanced technology and
state-of-the-art facilities to ensure precision, reliability, and efficiency in every part we
produce. As a company rooted in American manufacturing, we provide the stability, responsiveness,
and craftsmanship that global industries rely on.

Partner with GTP and experience the strength of U.S. manufacturing at its best.  Learn more about
GTP with this brief brochure [here][27].

[Placeholder image for Capabilities]

## Capabilities

GTP possesses the capacity to produce intricate injection molded parts, support minor engineering
adjustments and entirely new tooling projects. Our partnerships regionally and abroad offer
economical tooling solutions. The outcome is an injection mold capable of enduring the demanding
conditions of high-pressure injection molding effectively.

[More Info][28]

## Industries

GTP is a leading manufacturer of custom plastic injection molded components, boasting over four
decades of industry experience and IATF16949 certification. Our dedication to precision engineering
and unwavering commitment to excellence guarantee top-tier quality and reliability in every part
supplied to global companies.

[More Info][29]
[Placeholder image for Industries]
[Placeholder image for Products]

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,

offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## पार्ट-फीडिंग चुनौती से प्रोडक्शन-रेडी सिस्टम तक

आपके पहले सैंपल से प्रोडक्शन-रेडी सिस्टम तक — यहाँ बताया गया है कि हम इसे कैसे काम करते हैं, चरण दर चरण।

[वास्तविक फीडिंग चुनौती को स्पष्ट करें - Huben Automation]01

चरण 01 / डायग्नोस

### वास्तविक फीडिंग चुनौती को स्पष्ट करें

हम पार्ट ज्योमेट्री, आवश्यक ओरिएंटेशन, साइकल टारगेट और डाउनस्ट्रीम हैंडऑफ से शुरू करते हैं। इससे ओवरबाइंग, अंडर-डिज़ाइनिंग
या गलत प्लेटफॉर्म को आपकी लाइन में जबरन फिट करने से बचा जाता है।
* पार्ट सैंपल, CAD और प्रोडक्शन संदर्भ की समीक्षा करें
* ओरिएंटेशन जोखिम, कॉस्मेटिक सीमाओं और PPM टारगेट को मैप करें
* पहचानें कि स्टैंडर्ड, फ्लेक्सिबल या हाइब्रिड फीडिंग सबसे उपयुक्त है

[सही फीडर और टूलिंग रणनीति का मिलान करें - Huben Automation]02

चरण 02 / इंजीनियर

### सही फीडर और टूलिंग रणनीति का मिलान करें

कुछ एप्लिकेशन को टिकाऊ वाइब्रेटरी बॉल की आवश्यकता होती है। अन्य को फ्लेक्सिबल फीडिंग, एलीवेटर या संपूर्ण ऑटोमेशन सेल
की जरूरत होती है। समाधान केवल गति के आसपास नहीं, स्थिरता के आसपास चुना जाता है।
* बॉल, फ्लेक्सिबल फीडर, हॉपर या कस्टम सेल आर्किटेक्चर चुनें
* वास्तविक प्रोडक्शन परिस्थितियों के लिए ओरिएंटेशन टूलिंग को अनुकूलित करें
* थ्रूपुट, चेंजओवर, फुटप्रिंट और बजट को संतुलित करें

[व्यावहारिक फैक्ट्री सहायता के साथ तेज़ लॉन्च करें - Huben Automation]03

तेज़ संचार के माध्यम से आपकी टीम को स्टार्टअप फ्रिक्शन कम करने में मदद करते हैं।

## पार्ट-फीडिंग चुनौती से प्रोडक्शन-रेडी सिस्टम तक

आपके पहले सैंपल से प्रोडक्शन-रेडी सिस्टम तक — यहाँ बताया गया है कि हम इसे कैसे काम करते हैं, चरण दर चरण।

[वास्तविक फीडिंग चुनौती को स्पष्ट करें - Huben Automation]01

चरण 01 / डायग्नोस

### वास्तविक फीडिंग चुनौती को स्पष्ट करें

हम पार्ट ज्योमेट्री, आवश्यक ओरिएंटेशन, साइकल टारगेट और डाउनस्ट्रीम हैंडऑफ से शुरू करते हैं। इससे ओवरबाइंग, अंडर-डिज़ाइनिंग
या गलत प्लेटफॉर्म को आपकी लाइन में जबरन फिट करने से बचा जाता है।
* पार्ट सैंपल, CAD और प्रोडक्शन संदर्भ की समीक्षा करें
* ओरिएंटेशन जोखिम, कॉस्मेटिक सीमाओं और PPM टारगेट को मैप करें
* पहचानें कि स्टैंडर्ड, फ्लेक्सिबल या हाइब्रिड फीडिंग सबसे उपयुक्त है

[सही फीडर और टूलिंग रणनीति का मिलान करें - Huben Automation]02

चरण 02 / इंजीनियर

### सही फीडर और टूलिंग रणनीति का मिलान करें

कुछ एप्लिकेशन को टिकाऊ वाइब्रेटरी बॉल की आवश्यकता होती है। अन्य को फ्लेक्सिबल फीडिंग, एलीवेटर या संपूर्ण ऑटोमेशन सेल
की जरूरत होती है। समाधान केवल गति के आसपास नहीं, स्थिरता के आसपास चुना जाता है।
* बॉल, फ्लेक्सिबल फीडर, हॉपर या कस्टम सेल आर्किटेक्चर चुनें
* वास्तविक प्रोडक्शन परिस्थितियों के लिए ओरिएंटेशन टूलिंग को अनुकूलित करें
* थ्रूपुट, चेंजओवर, फुटप्रिंट और बजट को संतुलित करें

[व्यावहारिक फैक्ट्री सहायता के साथ तेज़ लॉन्च करें - Huben Automation]03

चरण 03 / डिलीवर

### व्यावहारिक फैक्ट्री सहायता के साथ तेज़ लॉन्च करें

डिलीवरी केवल हार्डवेयर शिप करने से अधिक है। हम वीडियो, रिमोट गाइडेंस, स्पेयर पार्ट्स प्लानिंग और कमीशनिंग के दौरान
तेज़ संचार के माध्यम से आपकी टीम को स्टार्टअप फ्रिक्शन कम करने में मदद करते हैं।
* FAT तैयारी, स्टार्टअप और प्रोसेस ट्यूनिंग का समर्थन करें
* सेटअप गाइडेंस, मैनुअल और ट्रबलशूटिंग सहायता साझा करें
* WhatsApp, ईमेल और वीडियो कॉल के माध्यम से तेज़ी से प्रतिक्रिया दें

design
to mold making and molded parts manufacturing. We are capable of bringing injection molded
product ideas into reality for a wide range of industries and applications.

## One-Stop Plastic Injection Molding Services

[computer-screen-showing-mold-design]
[ Plastic Product Design ][35]

When you need appealing products designed for manufacturability, simply provide us with a brief or
sketch of your ideas. Our creative team will deliver exemplary designs that distinguish your brand.

[engineers-discussing-in-front-of-computers]
[ Mold Design ][36]

FOW Mould is an injection mold supplier with decades of experience in mold design. Our molds are
precise, durable, and designed to be efficient in the manufacturing process.

[3d image of a plastic part]
[ 3D Printing ][37]

We are equipped with speedy high-resolution 3D printers that produce accurate prototypes in
elaborate detail. Our services are affordable and have a brief lead time of about 3 to 5 days.

[cnc machining]
[ CNC Machining ][38]

FOW Mould CNC machines are very precise and have high tolerances. This service is ideal for
prototyping and producing actual parts made of metal, resins or a combination of the two.

[molding making]
[ Mold Making ][39]

We offer mold-making services at competitive rates and deliver in short lead times. All processes
are performed under strict quality guidelines and the supervision of mold engineering experts.

[ABS-injection-molding]
[ Injection Molding ][40]

Our injection molding factory is fitted with ultra modern equipment that churns out hundreds of
injection molding parts on demand. We use premium quality materials for every project.

[insert molding]
[ Insert Molding ][41]

Insert molding is suitable for assembling metal and plastic parts quickly and smoothly. We can
design and manufacture all the components in-house and also insert-mold them for you.

[overmolding]
[ Overmolding ][42]

In overmolding, when the first layer of resin cools, a second layer of material is injected over it.
We provide this service and can source all the requisite materials for you.

[ Start Your Project Here ][43]

## Quality Is in Every Injection Mold and Plastic Parts

FOW takes care of all manufacturing tasks in house thus we are able to offer you an accuracy range
within 0.005mm for all molds and well-made injection molded parts.

FOW only uses high-quality metal steel for injection molds and qualified resin for plastic parts. We
are happy to provide composition analysis and other necessary test documents.

From raw material inspection and quality control through out the production process, we set up
strict standards and make sure that everything undergoes through the quality system.

[worker operating mold trials]

## Work with Our Experts for Customized
## Injection Molds and Products

Our team of designers and injection molding engineering experts are highly-qualified and
well-experienced in their craft. They keep up with evolving injection moulding industry trends and
are continuously innovating new cutting-edge solutions.

When you entrust us with your injection molding project, we handle it with utmost professionalism
and dedication. Every design detail will be custom-made to match your requirements and ease your
manufacturing process. 

We guarantee you a stress-free customer experience and complete discretion on all intellectual
property. Look no further. [Contact us][44] today and let us get started on your project. 

[our engineer team]

## Your Trusted Plastic Injection Molding Factory in China

FOW has an annual capability of 900 molds, 300 of which are bucket molds. Started from bucket molds,
we have expanded our mold-making and injection molding service to industries in warehouse & storage,
baby products, furniture, automobile and home appliances over the years. Our team of experienced
engineers can help you achieve an one-stop solution with both high quality and affordable injection
molding cost in China.

[certification]

capabilities, the company would expand – through strategic acquisitions, targeted capital
investments and organic growth – to a global, billion-dollar life science corporation.

## LS Manufacturing Delivers End-to-End Manufacturing Solutions

LS Manufacturing operates from its own factory in Dongguan, Guangdong, supported by a nationwide
network of certified partners. We provide a comprehensive range of precision manufacturing services,
including CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal fabrication, and 3D printing. Whether you
require rapid prototyping, low-volume production, or full-scale mass production, we are your trusted
partner for manufacturing complex custom parts with speed, precision, and reliability.

Precision milling and turning for prototypes and production. Achieve ±0.001" tolerances, 0.020" thin
walls, and lead times as fast as 1 day.

Fast, flexible molding from prototype to volume. No MOQ, T1 samples in 2 weeks, and scalable from 1
to 1M+ units.

Expert laser cutting, bending and welding. Get precision prototypes and production parts in 3 days,

Advanced SLA, SLS and MJF for functional prototypes and end-use parts. ±0.008" precision and 1-day

High-quality aluminum profiles with post-machining options. Tolerances to ±0.005, delivered in 10
days.

units.

UHMW (Ultra-High Molecular Weight Polyethylene) side blocks are utilized in continuous line
manufacturing processes for PUF (Polyurethane Foam) panels. These side blocks serve several critical
functions in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of the production line.

UHMW side blocks work as a guide to panels, maintain proper alignment, while passing through various
stages of manufacturing process. Nonstick properties of block prevent adhesion of foam to other
surface. It also absorbs vibrations impact of line to reduce the risk of damage of puf panels during
the manufacturing process.

We provide fully customized UHMW blocks with high quality standards. We manufacture various types of
blocks which are useful in various profile, angels and mounting options to optimize performance and
compatibility with existing conveyor system.

injecting procedure of polyurethane foam between metal sheets spacer provides dimension stability,

UHMW (Ultra-High Molecular Weight Polyethylene) side blocks are utilized in continuous line
manufacturing processes for PUF (Polyurethane Foam) panels. These side blocks serve several critical
functions in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of the production line.

UHMW side blocks work as a guide to panels, maintain proper alignment, while passing through various
stages of manufacturing process. Nonstick properties of block prevent adhesion of foam to other
surface. It also absorbs vibrations impact of line to reduce the risk of damage of puf panels during
the manufacturing process.

We provide fully customized UHMW blocks with high quality standards. We manufacture various types of
blocks which are useful in various profile, angels and mounting options to optimize performance and
compatibility with existing conveyor system.

## Who is Mr. Tan?

Independent sourcing agent based in Foshan, Guangdong. With over ten years of experience in the
e-commerce industry, including time spent at a Fortune 500 company, I have built extensive expertise
in dealing with manufacturers. I am now leveraging this background to serve as a professional [China
sourcing agent][20]. I truly hope to have the opportunity to cooperate with you, and I look forward
to proving my value through my dedication and sincerity.

[ More About MR. TAN → ][21]

## Why Overseas Buyers Partner With Mr. Tan

#### 1. Quality Assurance

I personally travel to the factories on the ground to inspect production lines and oversee quality
control. Your trusted eyes on the factory floor.

#### 2. Favorable Pricing

No middlemen and strictly refuse any kickbacks or commissions from manufacturers. My goal is to
secure the true ex-factory price for you, ensuring your products maintain a significant price
advantage in the market.

#### 3. Commitment

I won’t make empty promises that I am the “best” sourcing agent in China, but I guarantee that
absolute transparency and relentless sincerity are my unbreakable principles.

#### 4. Free Consultation

Complimentary, professional online guidance regarding China procurement, customs, and supplier
verification for overseas distributors.

MODULAR & STANDALONE SUPPORT

## Flexible Micro-Services Beyond Full Sourcing

In addition to our core end-to-end B2B sourcing agent service for bulk orders, overseas buyers can
also independently book these 3 targeted micro-services to solve immediate supply chain bottlenecks.

STANDALONE MODULE 01

NORTHERN PLASTICS

# Precision Injection Molds & CNC Machining Solutions

Northern Plastics with over 20 years of industry experience, is a modern machine house which brings
together industry’s most technologically-advanced computerized machining equipment with a highly
experienced engineering and manufacturing staff, with the sole purpose of continually providing our
customers with precise solutions in **CNC Machining Services, Precision Injection Molds and Plastic
Molded components**. Our humble beginnings, started with a few hand molding machines and evolved to
be the 2nd largest manufacturer of transformer bobbin in the country. Over the years, we have
developed extensive manufacturing expertise, business systems, and infrastructure, with the sole
purpose of continually providing our customers with precise solutions.

##### [What makes a good nameplate/Logo?][16]

Why say something in two dimensions when you can say it in three? 

ID3 Logos believes new businesses need a logo that speaks, is easily recognizable, and carries a
unique style. A well-designed nameplate is a natural extension of a strong logo.

Manufacturers often try to emulate the nameplate designs of the most recognizable brands in their
industry, often at great expense. While a brand may have a strong identity built over time, a closer
look at its branding techniques can reveal flaws new businesses should avoid. Take Marshall
Amplification, the gold standard of rock and roll sound. Its nameplate is a simple white plastic
logo in cursive lettering. Over time, Marshall made its name synonymous with exceptional sound
quality. However, imitating that logo will not give a new amplifier brand the same credibility.
Focus on originality, build a quality product, and over time your brand will stand on its own.


[So what are the rules of good nameplate design?][17]

Use a medium that complements your product packaging

Labels and domed labels are common and lack authority. Three-dimensional plastic or metal nameplates
create a stronger impression, allowing customers to see and physically interact with your brand.
Custom 3D nameplates provide greater control over depth, shape, and configuration.


Give your copy and logo room to breathe

White space is critical to good design. Adequate background space adds depth and emphasis to your
copy, creating balance between lettering and background.

# BLOW MOLDED PLASTIC WITH 99.9% ON-TIME DELIVERIES

#### 100% Employee Owned

[ Contact Us ][11]

## OMICO Plastics, Inc.

OMICO Plastics has spent more than 60 years creating blow molded plastic products for various
industries such as automotive, toy and appliance manufacturers. Plastics may make up your entire
product, or plastics may be the durable piece you need to complete a project. Our experts are here
to help you in the design process to create a custom molding experience specific to what you need.



OMICO Plastics is 100% employee-owned and so we take pride in every step of the process. Each of us
enjoy being able to see our products out in the real world. We watch a car drive past and are able
to say, “I made that car safer.” We gift a doll and can say, “I made that doll come to life, not
just for my child, but many.” Plastics are a part of every area of life today, and at OMICO we want
to continue providing quality, long lasting, custom, blow molded plastics. When we offer it to your
customers, we know we’re offering it to our families as well.



[ More about us ][12]

OMICO IS A WORLD-CLASS SUPPLIER OF CUSTOM PLASTIC COMPONENTS

### Automotive

The automotive industry has continually found that blow-molded plastics are a durable, safe, and
long-lasting alternative to metal parts that can quickly rust and corrode.

### Appliances

The appliance industry continues to turn to plastics as a viable option for their various part
needs. Blow molded plastics are a durable, economical choice that most industries are searching for.

### Toys

Blow molded toys provide fun and learning opportunities to kids around the world. That’s why OMICO
Plastics is proud to partner with toy manufacturers, bringing your ideas to life and getting safe
products into the hands of kids.

### Lawn/Garden

Walking through any lawn and garden aisle, there is no mistaking the importance of plastics to the
industry. As new ideas and products come onto the market, custom blow molds are increasingly needed.

# Premier Blow Molding Specialists

Paarlo Plastics produces high-quality, custom blow-molded parts using standard and engineering-grade
thermoplastics. 

With more than 40 years of experience, an 80,000-square-foot facility, and a responsive team
operating around the clock, we deliver precision, consistency, and reliability in every part.
Whether you need to solve a production challenge, replace an unreliable supplier, or develop a new
product, we make it easy to get your parts on time, built to spec. 

[ Request a Quote ][37]
[ Find Your Solution ][38]
[man pouring plastic pellets into bin]

## Quality Products and Processes

As a trusted partner for blow-molded parts, Paarlo is committed to making sure you get what you
need, when you need it. Our on-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery process removes friction from your
supply chain and keeps your production running smoothly. 

We combine decades of blow molding experience with advanced equipment and responsive service to
deliver consistent, high-quality plastic components. Whether you need standard or custom [blow
molded parts][39], Paarlo makes it simple to get results every time.

[Discover the Difference][40]

## Our Services

Focusing exclusively on blow molding plastic parts, Paarlo can handle projects from design to
delivery. 

[paarlo-icon-1]

#### Blow Molding & Equipment

Blow molding is the most cost-effective process for manufacturing hollow parts, with benefits
including lower tooling costs, seamless construction, and excellent flexibility.

[Discover the Difference ][41]
[paarlo-icon-2]

#### Engineering

Our engineering team optimizes processes and designs for cost savings, using lean principles to
eliminate waste and ensure quality in manufacturing.

[Streamline Your Design][42]
[paarlo-icon-3]

#### Assembly & Supply Chain Simplification

We offer secondary capabilities including punching, drilling, and sonic welding, plus complete
packout and shipment for on-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery.

[Simplify Your Supply Chain][43]

## Industries We Serve

From high-volume production to specialty applications, Paarlo delivers custom blow-molded plastic
parts across diverse industries with the quality, flexibility, and speed today’s manufacturers
demand.
[Check Mark]

### Automotive

Paarlo partners with Tier 1 and Tier 2 automotive suppliers to produce high-performance,
PPAP-compliant components. Our decades of experience and commitment to precision make us a reliable
partner for legacy platforms and new product launches alike.

[Explore Automotive Solutions][44]
[Check Mark]

### Toys

From durable play components to child-safe designs, Paarlo has supported top toy brands for over 40
years. Our blow molding capabilities deliver consistent quality, vibrant colors, and durable
performance that are ideal for large-volume consumer products.

[See Toy Manufacturing Capabilities][45]
[Check Mark]

### Medical

Paarlo’s clean, efficient facility and experience with complex blow-molded parts make us a trusted
supplier for non-invasive medical and wellness products. We deliver quality, consistency, and
responsiveness for partners who can’t afford delays or defects.

[Learn About Medical Applications][46]

## Why Manufacturers Choose Paarlo

We pride ourselves on excellent service, quality, and delivery. But don’t just take our word for it.
Hear why trusted brands in automotive, toys, and medical manufacturing choose Paarlo as their blow
molding partner.

[blow-molded-plastic-parts-quote]

### Tell Us About Your Project

[ Request a Quote ][47]

supply chain and keeps your production running smoothly.

deliver consistent, high-quality plastic components. Whether you need standard or custom [blow
molded parts][39], Paarlo makes it simple to get results every time.

delivery.

including lower tooling costs, seamless construction, and excellent flexibility.

eliminate waste and ensure quality in manufacturing.

[Streamline Your Design][42]

packout and shipment for on-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery.

parts across diverse industries with the quality, flexibility, and speed today’s manufacturers

Whether your product is big or small, delicate or uniquely shaped, getting it safely delivered to
the final destination is critical. That is where Peninsula Plastics comes in! Home of TUFF DUNNAGE®
solutions and the leader in “Advanced Freight Protection Technology” we offer first-in-class
solutions to all your challenging packaging needs.

Established in 1980, Peninsula Plastics specializes in manufacturing rugged plastic containers,
pallets, and trays.

No matter the challenge, Peninsula Plastics has a robust inventory of ready-to-go solutions. Each is
designed to let you push, pull, stack, store, and transport your most precious cargo across the
country, carefully and damage-free.

Struggling to find a packaging solution that safely encapsulates products with specific dimensions
and sizes? That’s okay, we can build it! We offer custom plastic packaging design solutions to meet
your exact specifications and needs.

### Injection Molding

Get affordable, high-quality molded parts and bridge tooling within days. With our free moldability
consultation, the design and molding process is rapidly accelerated to save you time and money.


[Learn More][134] 
* Low-volume molding up to 100,000+ parts with volume pricing available—no MOQ required
* 100+ plastic, elastomeric, and silicone rubber materials
* Automated CMM for fast, in-house quality documentation

 

[Blue anodized CNC part] CNC Machining expand_less expand_more

### CNC Machining

Leverage the same speed, precision, and reliability in machining that you’re accustomed to at
Protolabs but unlock advanced machining capabilities like tighter tolerances and volume pricing
through our manufacturing network.

[Learn More][135] 
* Machined parts in as fast as 1 day with optional plating and anodizing in as fast as 4 days
* Cost-efficient machined parts at higher volumes
* Tolerances down to ±0.001 in. (0.020mm) through our digital network

### 3D Printing

Want quality parts and additive expertise at a single 3D printing source? Choose from seven
different additive manufacturing technologies for cost-effective prototyping and highly precise,
repeatable production parts.

[Learn More][136] 
* Additive technologies include metal 3D printing, SLA, SLS, FDM, and more
* 30 plastic and metal materials in a range of finishes
* 25 years of additive manufacturing expertise

From easy quoting to quick-turn production and finishing options, get up to 500 quality sheet metal
parts in your hands in days from a single supplier.

* Instant quotes with interactive manufacturability feedback
* Six sheet metal materials including aluminum, stainless steel, steel, brass, and copper
* Finishing options from welding and hardware insertion to powder coating and silk screening

# Quad Plus: Engineering, Control System Integration & Power Systems

[industrial electrical engineering exterior quad plus building]

Quad Plus is an international engineering company that provides electrical services including
professional engineering, industrial controls and system integration solutions, power services and
repairs to a variety of industries. With a skilled design team made up of controls, mechanical,
civil, structural, chemical, and electrical engineers, Quad Plus has extensive process knowledge
spanning from the utility pole to the motor shaft. Our team of experienced experts can meet your
needs throughout the complete engineering lifecycle.

[Contact Quad Plus Now!][66]

## **End to End Integrated Engineering Solutions for Demanding Industrial Environments**

Quad Plus is an international engineering company combining industrial control systems integration,
power distribution expertise, and equipment repair services to support critical operations around
the world. Our team of controls, mechanical, civil, structural, chemical, and electrical engineers
works across the full engineering lifecycle, from initial studies and design through commissioning,
testing, and field service. Watch this video to see how we help customers in utilities, metals, oil
and gas, and manufacturing improve reliability, safety, and performance.

**End to End Integrated Engineering Solutions for Demanding Industrial Environments**

[industrial electrical engineering control eng systems integrator giants]
[industrial electrical engineering engineering linear dark]
[automation system integration life cycle]

## The Quad Plus Difference

### Entire Lifecycle

Whether you have a new automation system build, need to upgrade your current system, or retrofit an
outdated system, our team of expert engineers can meet your needs.

### Turnkey Solutions

Our system integration team will partner with you and manage your entire project from beginning to
end and beyond. Our goal is to make the process as smooth as possible for you.

### Industry Experts

Our engineers know your control systems because they have worked in the industries they support.
They also received additional training, certifications, and have access to specialized manufacturer
resources.

### Remote Support & Diagnostics

Most issues can be fixed quickly via our secure remote support system. If the technicians are not
able to resolve the issue, remotely, they will be prepped with the tools and equipment they need to
resolve the issue when they come onsite.

### 3D Design and Packaging

At Quad Plus, our team uses 3D modeling to virtually design cabinets and control layouts. This
allows you to see where the cabinet will be located and make alterations before anything is built,
which saves you time.

### Value Add

Installing a system is only one part of what we do; we perform every aspect of control system
integration. With years of experience in many industries, not only do our controls do the task
required, but our multi-system process knowledge that goes into system designs is second to none.
