# Recto Molded Products

## Molders of Plastics Since 1919

[hero_bottom_altered]

## Testimonials

“We would like to thank your company for always being a company that stands by their products and
services. Recto Molded pays close attention to the smallest detail to mold our parts efficiently.
Also your staff is always friendly and courteous.”

Systems Integrator

“Recto Molded produces quality products with great customer service! Thanks!”

Buyer

“Recto Molded Products is a long term supplier to our business that provides products with great
quality and very good on time delivery.”

Packaging Equipment Builder

“Recto has been a wonderful partner throughout our new product development projects. They provide
exceptional technical design support as well as customer service”

Sourcing Specialist
[intro-still]

For over 100 years, Recto Molded Products has been an innovative manufacturer of molded plastic
parts and assemblies. We are a versatile and trusted partner to customers ranging in size from
start-ups to multinational corporations, finding more effective and efficient ways to supply
high-quality plastic products to all of our customers.


## Services

Recto offers everything from Design & Engineering to Injection Molding to Secondary Operations
serving a wide variety of industries.

### Injection Molding

Our injection molding presses range from 55 to 500 tons, and in our dedication to consistently
upgrading our facility, many of our presses feature 6-axis robotic integration.

[ Learn More ][25]

### Assembly

In addition to our engineering and manufacturing capabilities, Recto’s team also performs a range of
value-added secondary services, such as assembly and finishing on the parts that we manufacture.

[ Learn More ][26]

### Design & Engineering

Recto’s team brings several decades of experience and expertise in Design, Engineering, and
Manufacturing.

[ Learn More ][27]

### Tooling

Our engineering support is available through production for building and testing our production
tooling and ensuring that everything processes as intended.

[ Learn More ][28]

## Quality

Our team develops individual quality control plans for each project that are customized to suit each
item or component’s specifications. These quality policies are developed most often with ISO 9000
guidelines, and guide all of our inspection procedures, from conventional measurement to more
intricate evaluations of the part’s fit, form, and function. Recto was and continues to be built on
a foundation of quality–both in our manufacturing processes and our customer service.

[ Learn More ][29]

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/info**][41]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Events]

### Renewable Carbon Events

nova-Institute hosts workshops and conferences, big and small, for an expert audience. Some related
to our research projects, some as stand-alone events. Most notable the Renewable Materials
Conference ([www.renewable-materials.eu][42]), International Conference on Cellulose Fibres
([www.cellulose-fibres.eu][43]), Conference on CO2-based Fuels and Chemicals
([www.co2-chemistry.eu][44]) and the nova Sessions, a series of workshops on pressing political
issues and market developments. On this website, you can find all upcoming events.

digital and artificial intelligence – carbon, capture and utilization – bio-based materials –

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Renewable Carbon]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/info**][41]

### Renewable Carbon Events

to our research projects, some as stand-alone events. Most notable the Renewable Materials
Conference ([www.renewable-materials.eu][42]), International Conference on Cellulose Fibres
([www.cellulose-fibres.eu][43]), Conference on CO2-based Fuels and Chemicals
([www.co2-chemistry.eu][44]) and the nova Sessions, a series of workshops on pressing political
issues and market developments. On this website, you can find all upcoming events.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/events**][45]

## Our Services

Rosti is a global partner in advanced plastic manufacturing and end-to-end production solutions.
With deep expertise, strong engineering capabilities, and a clear focus on quality, we support our
customers from concept to finished product.

### [Plastic Injection Moulding][77]

Our team of expert engineers and technicians have been offering precision plastic injection moulding
for over 80 years.

### [Contract Manufacturing][78]

Contract manufacturing for a complete end-to-end service, with the global resources to handle
large-scale projects, combined with flexibility and attention to detail.

### [Medical Solutions][79]

Providing the highest level of standards to meet your requirements on medical production.

### [Manufacturing Support][80]

From product development and design, to supply chain management and distribution, we have the
knowledge and capabilities to provide innovative solutions to the highest levels of accuracy and
reliability.

## Why Rosti?

### [Over 80 Years Expertise][81]

Founded in 1944

### [13 Manufacturing Sites][82]

A global footprint with strategically placed facilities

### [State of the art Innovations Lab][83]

Taking your products ‘from concept to reality

### [Leading Edge Services][84]

From design to delivery and everything in between

## Sustainability Built Into Every Process

As a plastic moulding company and contract manufacturer, Rosti sits at the center of the supply
chain and has a duty and an opportunity to make a positive environmental impact on the plastics
industry.

### 100% Clean Energy

Always use clean energy at all our sites.

### 100% Green Material Option

Always offer alternatives made from recycled or renewable materials

### 100% Recyclable Design options

Challenge all designs to become more sustainable

Do more with less energy, targeting a 50% improvement by 2040

## Our Services

Rosti is a global partner in advanced plastic manufacturing and end-to-end production solutions.
With deep expertise, strong engineering capabilities, and a clear focus on quality, we support our
customers from concept to finished product.

### [Plastic Injection Moulding][77]

Our team of expert engineers and technicians have been offering precision plastic injection moulding
for over 80 years.

### [Contract Manufacturing][78]

Contract manufacturing for a complete end-to-end service, with the global resources to handle
large-scale projects, combined with flexibility and attention to detail.

### [Medical Solutions][79]

Providing the highest level of standards to meet your requirements on medical production.

### [Manufacturing Support][80]

From product development and design, to supply chain management and distribution, we have the
knowledge and capabilities to provide innovative solutions to the highest levels of accuracy and
reliability.

Founded in 1944

## Explore our Full Product Line Catalog

Be inspired, see how people use these materials to reach new creative heights for making molds,
industrial parts, special effects, props, models, sculpture and much more.

View online, download as PDF, or request your FREE copy:

[› Click Here][31] [› Versión en Español][32]

## Explore our Concrete Catalog

We have a new eye-catching catalog devoted exclusively to concrete-related applications and
processes. It is a compilation of past high-profile concrete mold making projects and also features
a never before seen project.

View online, download as PDF, or request your FREE copy:

[› English Version][33] [› Versión en Español][34]

## Informational Links

[Are you an Educator or Student?][35]

Smooth-On works with teachers and students at colleges and universities to educate people on how
liquid rubbers, plastics, foams and other materials can be used for an infinite number of
applications.

[› Read more][36]
[Need a Mold or Casting Made?][37]

For those of you interested in having molds or castings made for you, we are pleased to suggest a
list of professional mold makers and casters who can do it for you.

[› Read more][38]
[Looking for Custom Formulations?][39]

Our chemists have many years of combined experience and are respected industry wide for their
individual expertise and development capability. There are minimum volume requirements for
manufacturing a custom formulation and we will be happy to discuss this and other variables to
determine what is possible.

[› Read more][40]

###### About Smooth-On, Inc.

You may never have heard of us, but you've seen our products at work. If you've ever been to the
movies, admired a piece of sculpture, marveled at detailed architectural ornamentation or used a
telephone; then you've encountered the handiwork of people who use Smooth-On rubbers, plastics,
foams and other products to turn their ideas into 3-dimensional reality.
[Learn more about us ›][41]

can locate technical data on hundreds of thousands of products in one easy-to-use search engine.

development. You can request samples from multiple suppliers within your Prospector account for
simple order organization. All product listings include the supplying company’s contact information

## Cases

Innovation is our soul, technology is our strength
* Surgical Instruments
* Laryngoscope Blades
* Surgical Forceps
* Life Detector Shell
Precision Plastic Shell Components for Medical Surgical Instruments
Yize Mould specializes in the research, development, and production of high-precision plastic
components for the medical field, offering one-stop solutions that encompass mold design, material
selection, and clean injection molding. The precision plastic shell components for medical surgical
instruments are crafted from high-performance engineering plastics such as PEEK, PEI, PPSU, and LCP,
exhibiting exceptional resistance to high temperatures, sterilization, chemical corrosion, and
biocompatibility.
Medical-grade High-Transparency PC Material
The laryngoscope blades are precise medical devices used for clinical airway observation and
intubation procedures, widely applied in departments such as anesthesiology, emergency medicine, and
otolaryngology. Yize Mould provides mold design and injection molding solutions for laryngoscope
plastic components and overall structures, producing key components in a dust-free injection molding
workshop and offering support for complete unit assembly and functional testing, facilitating rapid
mass production for clients.
Disposable Medical Plastic Surgical Forceps
Medical surgical forceps are a category of high-precision medical instruments used in clinical
surgeries for grasping, holding, or separating tissues, demanding extremely high standards of safety
and reliability. Surgical forceps components of different models and functions can be customized
according to client requirements.
High Precision, Supporting Three-Proof Design
The life detector is a high-precision device applied in scenarios such as emergency rescue,
earthquake search and rescue, mine safety and security, and medical monitoring, imposing stringent
requirements on the structural strength, protection level, and environmental adaptability of its
shell. Yize Mould focuses on injection molding of high-performance engineering plastics, providing
integrated solutions for life detectors that cover structural design, mold development, injection
production, and surface treatment.
